articleTitle: Signal Processing Techniques for LFMCW Radar under Urban Low, Slow, and Small Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth analysis of the Linear Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (LFMCW) radar, focusing on its application in urban environments for detecting low, slow, and small (LSS) targets. The paper comprehensively examines the operational range, noise characteristics, system loss, error sources, and various signal processing schemes of LFMCW radar. Special attention is given to the array radar technology, emphasizing its significance in modern radar systems and how it enhances target detection through techniques like Intermediate Frequency Quadrature Sampling, Amplitude and Phase Error Correction, Target Parameter Estimation, and Constant False Alarm Rate Detection. The research underscores the system's capability in simultaneous multi-beam formation, crucial for accurate target detection and angle measurement in challenging urban scenarios. The findings indicate that LFMCW radar, equipped with advanced signal processing techniques, offers robust performance in detecting LSS targets, making it highly suitable for applications in areas like airport airspace control, military surveillance, and public event security.

articleTitle: An improved lightweight tracking algorithm for the Low-Small-Slow target
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of diminished tracking precision and real-time capabilities in single-target tracking algorithms within small, low-altitude, and low-velocity target datasets, this research introduces an enhanced Discriminative Model Prediction (DiMP) tracking approach utilizing a lightweight neural architecture. Initially, the lightweight network is employed to construct an efficient feature extraction framework tailored for the DiMP algorithm. Subsequently, to augment the detection of diminutive targets, a multi-scale fusion module is integrated subsequent to the feature extraction mechanism. This module amalgamates the feature representations from each stratified output of the extraction network in both anterograde and retrograde directions, ensuring a feature map replete with extensive image details for the succeeding prediction module. Empirical validation of the refined algorithm on a bespoke dataset indicates a 0.04 increment in the success rate and a 10% enhancement in average processing speed per image, relative to the DiMP50 variant grounded in ResNet50.

articleTitle: Edge-constrained Residual Semantic Attention for Image Restoration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Currently, image restoration models have achieved significant advancements. However, in cases where the missing regions are too large, it often leads to erroneous structures and inconsistent blurry textures with the surrounding areas. To further enhance the performance of image restoration algorithms, we propose a two-stage model—based on edge constraints and residual semantic attention for image restoration. In the first stage, an edge structure generation network is employed to learn and restore missing edge structure information. Subsequently, in the second stage, the complete edge structure information assists a content-texture restoration network in generating the entire image. This involves initially using gated convolutions to extract effective features. Furthermore, a Residual Semantic Attention module (RSA) is designed, replacing regular convolutional kernels with regions known from the image itself. It applies residual combination and additional convolution to enhance the semantic coherence of foreground and background regions while maximizing the retention of original feature information.

articleTitle: Collaborative Learning for Multi-Source Domain Adaptative Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Multi-Source domain adaptation is a more general scenario than single-source domain adaptation, however, it encounters challenges arising from the problem of model effect degradation caused by distribution differences between multiple source domains. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach, namely collaborative learning(CL). CL can retain public intra-domain knowledge and improve the generalization ability of the model. Extensive experiments on different adaptation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-based Collision and Conflict Warning System for Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: As an important part of the future intelligent transportation, the Internet of Vehicles is one of the indispensable technology to realize intelligent transportation. With the development of the technology of the Internet of Vehicles, Safety issues are becoming increasingly prominent. If it's possible to receive an early warning and make decisions for vehicles before dangers arise, the likelihood of accidents can be significantly reduced. This article aims to design a vehicle network collision conflict warning system based on digital twins. Utilizing the features of digital twins, it broadly collects and analyzes drivers' historical travel habits and driving behaviors. The system anticipates which vehicles will appear in different sections at different times and predicts their next potential actions. It then categorizes and filters out dangerous drivers and determines the danger zones. Subsequently, the danger zones and subsequent system decision recommendations are broadcast to pedestrians and vehicles within the vicinity. This article uses MATLAB for simulation, employs the k-means algorithm for categorization, and calculates and plots the warning zones. Ultimately, the results fully met expectations.

articleTitle: A Novel Jamming Architecture of Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave Synthetic Aperture Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The traditional jammer uses an architecture of superheterodyne receiver and a method of direct sampling of intermediate frequency (IF) signal, which is costly and difficult for implementation. A new jammer architecture based on dechirp reception that can significantly reduce the sampling rate, and further reduce cost and signal processing complexity is proposed in this paper. In response to the problem of mirror interference in dechirp reception and inverse dechirp transmission, a novel solution of using a local oscillator (LO) signal with fixed frequency offset is introduced, and an experimental jammer system is constructed to verify the feasibility of the proposed architecture. Finally, an effective jamming on a ground-based FMCW-SAR is achieved.

articleTitle: Seismic Signal Denoising Method Based on Generalized Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The denoising of seismic signals contributes to an enhanced signal-to-noise ratio, thereby improving the quality of subsequent research work. This study employs a diffusion probability model to diffuse and reverse seismic signals in the STEAD dataset, simulating the process of noise contamination and removal, achieving effective signal recovery under different noise conditions. In practical applications, this study overlays actual noise with Gaussian noise as synthetic noise for the forward diffusion process and extracts the time-frequency characteristics of the resulting noisy seismic signal as conditional assistance for model training. This approach overcomes the general diffusion model’s reliance on pure Gaussian noise and enhances the model’s generalization ability. The experimental results demonstrate that the model significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio of seismic signals, which is of great significance for the advancement of subsequent research in the field of seismology.

articleTitle: Airworthiness Test Method of Ka-band Satellite Communication System for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Broadband satellite communication is one of main means of communication in civil aircraft cabin. This paper focus on broadband satellite communication system with Ka frequencies, giving a brief introduction firstly and then starting with CCAR25 airworthiness regulations, analyzing the airworthiness provisions that the system needs to meet, and discussing the method of conformity verification. Then, from the two aspects of ground test and flight test, the test method of Ka broadband satellite communication system to demonstrate the conformity is introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Similarity Relation Representation Learning based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: With the advance of the Internet of Things (IoT), massive Spatio-Temporal (ST) data are collected, providing an unprecedented opportunity to study human mobility. Extracting similarity information from such vast ST data is crucial for data mining tasks, such as clustering, classification, prediction, etc. In modern Location Based Services (LBS), deep representation learning is employed to embed ST data into a low-dimensional vector space for extracting similarity information. Recent deep learning approaches leverage sequential models for similarity relation representation; however, these methods are inefficient and their performance is impacted by data length. In this work, we propose Graph-based Spatio-Temporal Representation (GSTR) which exploits similarity relation representation learning on the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) graph with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), efficiently capturing the original ST similarity. The experiments demonstrate that GSTR outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines, including matrix factorization approaches and deep learning methods in terms of similarity preservation, dimension reduction and representation efficiency.

articleTitle: Semantic Feedback for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The goal of Generalized Zero-Shot Learning (GZSL) methods is to classify unseen classes during testing, where no available data is provided during training. Unlike zero-shot recognition, test samples of GZSL include both seen and unseen classes. Current feature generation methods are based on generative adversarial networks, which synthesize visual features for unseen classes using their semantic descriptors. However, these methods still struggle to address the bias between seen and unseen classes. Therefore, this paper proposes a Semantic Feedback (SF) module based on generative adversarial models to mitigate the bias between seen and unseen classes. Specifically, we introduce a semantic feedback module with a feedback mechanism that iteratively improves the generated features during the training and feature synthesis stages. The synthesized visual features, along with their corresponding latent features, are then refined into discriminative features for the classification process to reduce class ambiguity. Competitive results obtained on four popular benchmark datasets demonstrate the significant potential and superiority of this proposed method.

articleTitle: A research on Bayesian optimisation of bilstm neural network algorithms-application to photovoltaic power prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Optimizing the hyperparameters of neural network plays a crucial role in improving the prediction accuracy of neural network, this paper proposes a neural network prediction model based on Bayesian optimization Bi-LSTM, and conducts an example analysis in PV power generation prediction. Firstly, the input parameters of the neural network are determined, which mainly include the influencing factors of PV power generation, such as temperature, pressure, humidity and radiation. Then, the number of hidden layer neurons, initial learning rate and L2 regularization parameters of the network were optimized by Bayesian optimization of the hyperparameters of the Bi-LSTM neural network algorithm, and then the optimized hyperparameters were used as the parameters of the final Bi-LSTM model. Finally, the effective role of the method is verified by example simulation. The simulation results show that the PV prediction results obtained by the Bayesian optimized Bi-LSTM network algorithm used in this paper are more accurate and have higher prediction accuracy compared with the traditional neural network method.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Based on Dual Decomposition and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of power loads is crucial to guarantee the efficient, stable and safe operation of power system. In this paper, a short-term load forecasting method based on dual decomposition, sparrow optimization algorithm and long short-term memory (LSTM) network is proposed to enhance prediction accuracy. Firstly, empirical modal decomposition (EMD) is used to decompose the original time series into a series of modal components with different central frequencies, followed by the reconstruction based on sample entropy clustering to reduce training time and cumulative error caused by IMF prediction. Secondly, a dual decomposing by using variational modal decomposition (VMD) is performed to extract the features of high-frequency components. Finally, LSTM is utilized to predict all the components and are summed to get the final prediction. The Sparrow Optimization Algorithm (SSA) optimizes the parameters of VMD and LSTM. The experiments show that the prediction accuracy is greatly improved compared with other traditional models, and can be effectively applied to short-term load forecasting.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal Attention-Based Time Series Prediction Network for Lithium Battery Remaining Useful Life Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The accurate estimation of the remaining useful life (RUL) of lithium batteries is a pivotal aspect in battery management systems, essential for efficient battery management, optimization of battery performance, and enhanced user experience. Presently, prevailing deep learning methods for battery RUL estimation mainly focus on individual neural networks, overlooking the crucial spatial-temporal characteristics. In this study, we introduce a time series prediction framework employing a gate recurrent unit (GRU) in tandem with a spatial-temporal attention mechanism. Our methodology involves initially screening data associated with high correlation to battery capacity through correlation coefficient analysis. This screened data is then processed by a series of GRU network layers to model the relationship between battery input and capacity. Following this, the extracted features undergo a deeper level analysis, whereby a spatial-temporal attention mechanism assigns varying weights to these features in the temporal and spatial dimensions to capture correlations more intricately. We evaluated the proposed method on the NASA dataset, and the experimental findings validate that our network achieves accurate time series predictions with an MAE of less than 1.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In real life, robots are subject to multiple constraints when moving in complex scenes, which can lead to problems such as poor optimization ability, unsmooth path planning, and slow convergence speed of search algorithms. A robot path planning method based on improved genetic algorithm is proposed to address the above issues. Firstly, a grid method is used to construct the mobile environment of the robot, and a model is constructed under constraints such as path smoothness, path length, and path difficulty; Then, the traditional genetic algorithm was improved through smoothing operators and its performance was verified through experiments. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively handle path planning problems under multiple constraint conditions and find the most suitable smooth path for robot motion. Through comparative experiments, this method has relative advantages in path length, smoothness, and runtime.

articleTitle: Analysis of logistics cargo turnover prediction based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Cargo turnover is an important indicator of the country's economic development, and the prediction of future logistics cargo turnover can meet the future economic development. This paper proposes an artificial neural network model to predict the logistics cargo turnover in China, introduces Bayesian optimization algorithm artificial neural network model hyperparameters, uses the logistics cargo turnover in China from 1978 to 2021 as the training set and test set, trains, tests and examines the artificial neural network model, gets the optimal parameters suitable for the prediction of logistics cargo turnover, and finally predicts the logistics cargo turnover in China in the next three years. Finally, it predicts the logistics freight turnover of China in the next three years. China's logistics freight turnover will continue to grow in the future, the economic development momentum is good, the prediction method proposed in this paper, the advantages and disadvantages of socio-economic development has an important significance to grasp

articleTitle: Nonlinear Equalization Based on CV-CNN for 16-QAM Coherent Optical OFDM Signal at 350GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In the 350 GHz 16-QAM coherent optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) communication system, we propose an equalizer based on complex-valued convolutional neural networks (CV-CNN) to achieve nonlinear equalization of the signal. In terms of improving system performance, not only can complex signals be directly processed without using two networks respectively, but can also achieve a 9.2 dB Q-value improvement over 40 km standard single mode fiber (SSMF) compared to traditional equalization methods that do not use neural networks (NN).

articleTitle: A Method for Distributing Traffic Chain with Containerized Security Capability
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In order to achieve more efficient and reasonable distribution of traffic service chains, this paper proposes a traffic service chain distribution method based on K-medoids artificial bee colony algorithm. We introduce PWLCM mapping to complete population initialization and uses K-medoids clustering to achieve step size adaptation in artificial bee colony algorithm. By continuously cross exploring the honey source, bees in tradition artificial bee colony algorithm tend to get stuck in local optimal solutions in their neighborhoods. The proposed algorithm can prevent the solution from falling into local optima and premature convergence problems. The way which combines the traffic distribution method with Swarm intelligence technology can improve the distribution efficiency of traffic business chain.

articleTitle: Accelerating pose estimation with depthwise separable convolutions on FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Pose estimation has a wide range of application scenarios. The deep learning model it uses is mainly a CNN, which can effectively identify human postures, expressions, gestures, etc. in visual texts such as videos. However, complex neural networks for pose estimation result in longer inference time and resource consumption. This article explores methods to accelerate the implementation of CNN for pose estimation on FPGA. We designed a more lightweight and accurate pose estimation neural network. In particular, we use the lightweight MobileNet model and depthwise separable convolution technology, while streamlining the network to adapt to the hardware characteristics of FPGA and optimize performance. Our method significantly improves computational speed and energy efficiency while maintaining high recognition accuracy. The platform used is Xilinx Zynq zcu 104, which has good performance and low resource utilization.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of high speed performances of silicon microring modulators
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Silicon microring resonator modulators have become a promising candidate of high-speed optical modulators due to its compact footprint, low energy consumption and flexible structure. A silicon microring resonator with radius of 10 µm and rib waveguide is adopted for optical modulation by using carrier injection effect. The optical mode distribution, coupling coefficient, transmission spectrum, eye diagrams, bit error ratio and electro-optic response are studied. Microring modulators with three different gaps corresponding to different coupling conditions are analyzed and compared. Results show that the microring modulator at over coupling condition with coupling coefficient of 0.02 exhibits the best performance. It realizes a high speed of 80 Gbit/s, 3dB bandwidth of 42 GHz, low bit error ratio of 1.0×10<sup>-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Network flow prediction by AC-GRU based on improved attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Network flow prediction is the key to urban network planning as well as network load balancing. However, due to the highly nonlinear nature of network flow, some traditional methods are difficult to extract its complex spatio-temporal features, resulting in low prediction accuracy. To address this problem, this paper proposes a GRU model AC-GRU based on improved attention mechanism for network flow prediction. AC-GRU extracts the spatio-temporal features of the flow using improved attention mechanism GRU, convolutional GRU, respectively, and then adaptively fuses the features using bilateral gating mechanism. In this paper, experiments are conducted on three public network flow datasets GEANT, CERNET and ABILENE, and RMSE and ACC are used as evaluation metrics. The experimental results show that the AC-GRU method can achieve better prediction results.

articleTitle: Research on Power Communication Technology Based on 5G Local Area Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: 5G LAN is a technology that uses 5G networks to provide local area network (LAN)-virtual network services, and provides private mobile communication services through 5G systems, allowing limited terminal groups to perform Ethernet or IP-based point-to-point 2-Layer communication within a 5G LAN virtual network. The use of 5G LAN can replace Wi-Fi to achieve a wider range of regional coverage, providing VPN-like services for power park scenarios. In this paper, a development method of power communication terminal based on 5G LAN is tested to provide a reference for promoting the application and promotion of 5G in modern industrial fields.

articleTitle: A Method to Extract the Time-Frequency Feature of Underwater Acoustic Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: One of the key techniques in the identification of underwater target is the analysis of the target underwater acoustic signal. Based on short-time Fourier transform method, this paper presents a extraction method to extract the feature of time-frequency about underwater acoustic signal by the target in water, simulation and analysis of the method is also taken in this paper. The results show that the method to extract the underwater acoustic signal time-frequency feature is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Equivalent inertia evaluation of new power system considering transient stability based on PSO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The transient stability of the power system is closely related to the level of inertia, so accurately evaluating the level of inertia is of great significance for transient stability. To more accurately evaluate the equivalent inertia level of new power system, this paper proposes an online evaluation method for equivalent inertia based on PSO-LSTM network. Firstly, conduct extensive time-domain simulations in a new power system containing wind turbines to obtain a dataset for training the network; Secondly, regarding the difficulty in selecting hyperparameters for LSTM networks, using the PSO algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters; Then, based on LSTM network, establish an equivalent inertia evaluation model that represents the mapping relationship between system operating data and equivalent inertia. Finally, simulation analysis is conducted based on the new energy IEEE39 Buses system. The simulation results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in inertia evaluation of new power system.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Dilated Sparse Convolution for 3D Point Cloud Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: With the rapid development of unmanned driving and intelligent transportation, 3D point cloud object detection methods have received widespread attention. Due to the disorder, sparsity, and unstructured characteristics of point clouds, building an effective point cloud object detection network and improving its accuracy become challenging. Therefore, multi-scale dilated sparse convolution(MSD) for 3D point cloud object detection is proposed, which utilizes multiple branches and convolutional kernels with different scales to capture feature information and improve object detection accuracy. The experiment on the KITTI dataset shows that this method further improves the accuracy of object detection, with the mAP (mean Average Precision) of 77.75%, demonstrating the superiority of this method.

articleTitle: A routing optimization strategy for WSNs based on single-hop and Dijkstra's multi-hop algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: WSNs are being deployed on a large scale due to their low cost, good scalability, and ability to self-organize. A classic routing protocol for WSNs is the LEACH protocol. Network energy is the main problem facing WSNs, but the LEACH protocol does not consider current node energy, cluster density, or single-hop transmission, resulting in unbalanced network energy and a short network lifetime. Considering the aforementioned three points, LEACH-MAS, which is based on the Dijkstra algorithm, is put forward. The results of the simulation demonstrate that LEACH-MAS can successfully balance the network energy load and greatly increase the network's lifetime, throughput, and average energy.

articleTitle: Optimized Millimeter Wave AoA Localization in Indoor Parking Environments: A Precise Approach with Beam Forming and Antenna Analysis in Line of Sight Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In recent years, the demand for indoor localization techniques has grown rapidly. In order to meet such demand, this article focuses on indoor localization and proposes a novel application of AoA technology-based localization system. The main application scenario is inside an underground garage with line-of-sight, and a beam forming AoA positioning system is simulated using Matlab. Finally, an outlook of applications based on this system is presented.

articleTitle: Prediction of pipeline wax formation degree and evaluation of pigging effect based on timing drive
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: According to the field manual experience to determine the blindness of pigging cycle, in order to avoid the occurrence of excessive pigging phenomenon, based on the slow timing of the wax formation process, based on the study of the relationship between production data parameters and the degree of wax formation, the improved K-means algorithm was used to determine the degree of wax formation in different time series, and the data was introduced into the convolutional neural network (CNN). By using the feature extraction and adaptive learning ability of CNN model, the online update of duration of different degrees of wax formation was realized, and the pigging effect evaluation index model was constructed according to the changes of wax formation grade and pigging cycle, so as to realize the early warning of pigging operation. The results show that different pipelines have different grade time and cycle length in the complete paraffin pigging cycle, which reflects the different degree of paraffin pigging caused by the difference of input parameters. The improved K-means algorithm divides the degree of paraffin pigging into 4 grades; The overall average error of this model is 0.781d, which is smaller than 2.025d and 1.225d of the RNN model and the LSTM model. The pigging effect evaluation index of the pipeline to be evaluated is 0.828, indicating that the pigging effect is good. The research results can provide practical reference for the improvement of pipeline integrity management level.

articleTitle: Minimal Electrode EEG for BCI Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based emotion recognition is a potential research direction in the field of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, its deployment on wearable devices still suffers from the challenges of low accuracy, heavy computation, and complex electrode placement. This study focuses on advancing the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of EEG-based BCIs for emotion recognition. Our approach begins with an investigation of electrode placement in relation to emotion detection, leveraging the SEED dataset to identify an optimal configuration that uses a minimal number of electrodes while maintaining high recognition accuracy. Employing a variety of machine learning and deep learning algorithms, we compare detection accuracy across different electrode combinations. Through these experiments and subsequent analysis, we identify an effective combination of two electrodes, T7 and T8, with the SVM method achieving an impressive 92.8 % accuracy. This finding laid the foundation for the design of our wearable, closed-loop BCI device with EEG-based emotion recognition capability.

articleTitle: The Application of Machine Learning in Android Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The android system had been a popular system among mobile phone users, there are lots of applications based on android system, which contain malware and good software. Malware is very harmful to the computer because it can embed rubbish advertisements, applications and viruses in order to disrupt the functioning of your mobile phone or steal your personal information. Network information security has gained its significance on the internet which is related to our safety directly. The traditional method to detect malware is to use anti-virus software to check the mobile phone. However, with the rapid uploading and increase in the number of software, some malware cannot be detected well and also the anti-virus software may embed some advertisements or download bundle software (usually hard to uninstall) automatically by itself. With development, machine learning ’s calculation efficiency has been improved significantly and it has been used in many regions. In this paper, we select several typical machine-learning algorithms to build the malware detection model. Considering the unbalanced data, we made an unweighted and weighted model simultaneously. As a result, the weighted random forest model has the best effect and its accuracy is 98.94%

articleTitle: Controllable Template Generation for Document-level Event Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Document-level event extraction task has achieved significant progress based on template generation methods. However, there is no reasonable regulation and restriction in the existing template-based generation methods, which results in the uncontrollability of the generation results. In some scenarios, model generates entities that do not belong to the input text, or generate template content repeatedly. It is determined by the nature of the extraction task and the generation task. To this end, we propose a controllable template generation event extraction model. According to the characteristics of template generation and event extraction tasks, the model devises copy mechanism, inhibition mechanism and rejection mechanism under the appropriately constructed template. Our model achieves state-of-the-art result on MUC-4 dataset, and finally through experimental analysis, it demonstrates the effectiveness of each mechanism we proposed.

articleTitle: A Multi-step Water Level Prediction Model Based On CNN-LSTM-ATTENTION Combined With Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In order to improve the ability to predict river water levels, a multivariate multi-step water level prediction model using wavelet transform(WT) and attention mechanism combined with convolutional neural network(CNN) and long short-term memory network(LSTM) was proposed. In this model, the water level data is decomposed and reconstructed through WT by combining the water level characteristics of multiple water level stations and rainfall information. CNN and LSTM are used to obtain local feature information and time series features of the reconstructed hydrological data sequence. Finally, attention mechanism is introduced to assign adaptive weights to the output sequence of LSTM, and LSTM is used to output multi-step predicted water level data. The experimental results show that the water level prediction model incorporating rainfall information has achieved multi-step water level prediction for 96 consecutive hours, and has achieved good results in various evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Investigation of Single Channel Speech Enhancement: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Noise is a critical factor that impacts speech quality. Speech signals are often disturbed by noise during acquisition and transmission. Speech enhancement technology represents an important method to eliminate noise from noisy signal and extract clean speech, which holds significant value in the field of speech recognition, speech communication. This study first categorizes the prior characteristics of different types of noise, followed by an exposition and implementation of representative speech enhancement methods, including traditional signal processing methods and deep learning algorithms. Through three metrics of evaluation, the performance of various speech enhancement algorithms in distinct noise environments is compared, and the Entropy Weight-Topsis (EW-Topsis) method is used for synthesis. Finally, the applicability and development trends of existing speech enhancement algorithms were discussed. The innovation of this study lies in the comparison of different algorithms in various noisy environments using different evaluation metrics. Previous research has mainly focused on two of the evaluation, algorithms and noise. This study presents a comprehensive comparison to synthesize three aspects, providing a unified evaluation reference.

articleTitle: Target Detection Based on Phase Noise of Repeating Jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The repeating type of false target enters the radar receiver through the main lobe, realistically simulating the waveform of the real target in the time and frequency domains, posing a serious threat to radar search, recognition, and tracking. To improve the detection performance of radar in the above-mentioned interference scenarios, this paper models and analyzes the phase noise of the local oscillator of the jammer based on the phase noise difference between the jammer and the radar radio frequency (RF) system. On this basis, by establishing a statistical model for repeating jamming phase noise, utilizing the difference in phase noise between target echo and jamming signal, and based on Neyman Pearson (NP) theorem and generalized likelihood ratio tests (GLRT) method, a discriminative criterion is designed to achieve target detection in the background of interference. The effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm are verified by Monte Carlo simulation results.

articleTitle: Deep Echo Cancellation Algorithm based on Time-Frequency Domain Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) methods are difficult to deal with nonlinear echoes and complex echoes, this paper proposes a combined time-frequency domain AEC method, which captures the differences between inputs and outputs as well as the modelled time-series information through residual networks and gated recurrent unit (GRU) in the frequency domain and introduces a channel attention mechanism to adjust the feature weights of different channels, and then combines the outputs of the frequency-domain network in the time domain model is further optimized to improve the quality of the speech signal. The experimental results show that the evaluation scores of the proposed method are higher than those of the reference algorithm in the cases of far-end single-talk and double-talk, and it can effectively eliminate echoes.

articleTitle: Satirical News Headline Detection Based on BERT+LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: It is an important task to correctly identify the satirical features of news. Sarcasm detection, as a task of text classification in natural language processing, requires deep semantic information. Under the framework of Keras and Tensorflow, this experiment preprocessed text data, obtained word vector through BERT model, and then input LSTM model to obtain feature vector, and finally classified after dimensionality reduction. The experimental results on the standard satire detection dataset show that the proposed model has a high accuracy of irony detection classification.

articleTitle: Reversible Data Hiding for Encrypted Image Based on Block Mean Difference Histogram Shifting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Reversible data hiding in encrypted image (RDHEI) is essential to protect data privacy. In this paper, we propose a novel RDHEI method based on block mean difference histogram shifting. The data owner divides the cover image into nonoverlapping 2×2 image blocks and computes the block mean difference. To ensure the accessibility of the block mean differences, the data owner encrypts the image block using Paillier while binding the mean differences to the encrypted image block using the self-binding property of Paillier. The data hider extracts the mean difference from the encrypted image blocks in the data embedding phase. The block mean difference histogram is constructed by calculating the differences based on the additive homomorphic properties of encrypted pixels within a block to enhance the density of the histogram distribution. Subsequently, the data is embedded into the encrypted image by histogram shifting to generate the encrypted marked image. Due to the homomorphic property of Paillier, the data receiver can simultaneously extract the data and restore the image from either the encrypted marked image or the plaintext marked image without loss, which achieves separability. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs great in terms of image quality and embedding rate, and its PSNR and embedding rate outperforms similar existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Health Assessment Method of Train Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Train communication network is a data communication network that transmits information to all kinds of intelligent on-board equipment on the train. It is the basis for the whole train to realize information sharing, control function, monitoring and diagnosis. If the train communication network fails, it will pose a serious threat to the safe operation of the train. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the research on the online monitoring system of the health status of the train communication network, so as to grasp the health status information of the train communication network online, which will improve the safety and reliability of the train operation and realize the condition maintenance. In this paper, based on the research of online monitoring system for the health status of train communication network and the research status of PHM technology and health assessment of train communication network, an online assessment method for the health status of MVB network is proposed.

articleTitle: DGAttn: Knowledge Reasoning for Multidimensional Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Knowledge reasoning methods based on Reinforcement Learning, which have the performance advantages of neural network models and better interpretability, have rapidly become a research hotspot. However, for many knowledge graph environments, the sparseness of the knowledge graph itself determines the final reasoning effect. In order to solve the problem of lack of path links and negative paths in the reasoning process, we propose a reasoning method in small samples-DGAttn. Firstly, this model moves the representation learning based method into the reinforcement learning method, using the embedding result score as the reward for the path selection process. At the same time we introduce graph convolutional neural network module and attention module to perform bipartite union in regular action space and extra action space in order to integrate structural information and hierarchical feature information. The results of link prediction experiment on FB15K-237 and WD-singer datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms similar approaches in most reasoning tasks within sparse environments.

articleTitle: A Wind Power Cleaning and Prediction Model based on DBSCAN-RNN-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: To address the problems of incomplete cleaning of abnormal power data and low prediction accuracy in wind power prediction, this paper proposes a wind power cleaning and prediction model based on DBSCAN-RNN-BiLSTM. First, the data were classified into normal and abnormal categories using the Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise(DBSCAN) algorithm. Then, the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is trained using the delineated normal data and the abnormal power is corrected on the basis of the trained model. Finally, the cleaned power data is temporalized and wind power prediction is performed using a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM). The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can improve the quality of wind power data and increase the accuracy of wind power prediction.

Author Keywords: Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise

articleTitle: Passive Beamforming based on Cosine Similarity for Space Shift Keying with Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted transmission and space shift keying (SSK) appear as promising candidates for future wireless communication systems. In this paper, a low-complexity cosine similarity-based method for phase optimization in RIS-assisted SSK systems with passive beamforming is proposed. Specifically, based on cosine similarity, we optimize the phase shift of reflected elements by maximizing the Euclidean distance (ED) between the different emission vectors corresponding to the ideal received signal, which shows a lower complexity compared with the sub-exhaustive search algorithm. Moreover, the proposed method avoids the poor bit error rate (BER) performance of the method based on maximizing the instantaneous receive signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Our simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed solutions over the relevant benchmarks.

articleTitle: Design of task offloading algorithm for mobile edge computing network based on UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: This paper optimizes system performance in a UAV-based multi-user mobile edge computing system through joint design of UAV positions, computing service pricing, and user task offloading strategies. The Stackelberg model is used to optimize the interaction between ground users and UAVs . UAVs maximize revenue through pricing, while ground users minimize costs through task offloading strategies. This paper simplifies the problem by assuming known UAV positions. The pricing and task offloading subproblems are solved by obtaining the equilibrium solution of the game model. The UAV positioning subproblem is solved using a genetic algorithm, resulting in suboptimal solutions for the original problem through iterative iterations. The simulation results show that the algorithm leads to higher UAV revenue and reduced user latency.

articleTitle: Caching Video by Distributed Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Mobile edge computing is a new paradigm to support video caching, aiming to optimize the user’s viewing experience. However, existing works have focused on centralized algorithms, which require a powerful computing center to do scheduling to determine the video content that should be stored on which edge server closest to the user. Therefore, these approach put too much pressure on the backbone network, resulting in increased application costs and reducing its usefulness. To address the above limitation, we consider this scenario without any computing center and propose an innovative distributed video caching algorithm that is different from the previous centralized methods. In our scenario, we no longer need the support of the computing center, but only consider the information interaction between the edge nodes. Our objective is to reduce the average latency to improve the user experience. To this end, we propose a novel decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm, Distributed Algorithm Without Center (DAWC), implementing in decentralized training and decentralized execution. The main difference between our algorithm and the existing MARL algorithm is that our algorithm is trained distributed, while other algorithms are trained centrally. We further utilize a neural communication protocol to reduce information loss and non-stationary by introducing hidden state and differentiable message encoding and extracting functions. Extensive performance results show that the performance of DAWC is not significantly weaker than that of MARL algorithm with central participation in centralized learning, but other independent learning algorithm and random offloading strategy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-precision synchronized wireless
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In response to the high demands for amplitude and phase balance among channels in applications like phased-array radars, beamforming, and direction-finding systems, we constructed a high-precision synchronized Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) system based on FPGA XC7Z045 and multiple AD9361 modules. Each AD9361 module provides 2x2 transmit-receive channels. We employed a method utilizing calibration sources routed to individual receive channels and utilized FFT transformation for precise phase difference estimation. Through iterative optimization calibration, we ensured rapid convergence of phase differences among multiple channels. This abstract highlights an advanced approach compared to conventional calibration methods. Through testing and analysis, our system, operating at a 500MHz local oscillator frequency, maintains a multi-channel phase error of less than 0.4 degrees for extended periods. During frequency sweep tests in the 100MHz~1.25GHz band, the system consistently achieves phase error precision below 0.4 degrees after calibration. Compared to traditional calibration methods, our system demonstrates significant improvements in stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Computing Offloading for Energy Conservation in UAV-Assisted Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In the context of large-scale machine-type communication scenarios in 5G, there is a rapid increase in the number and complexity of user equipments' (UE) tasks. However, traditional cloud computing centers far from the UE fail to meet latency requirements. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) emerges as a solution by deploying computing servers at the edge of the cellular network to enhance service responsiveness. However, traditional MEC solutions need more flexibility. This paper explores the advantages of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), and considers UAV power constraints. It proposes a joint optimization approach for user offloading strategies and UAV trajectories to minimize the overall energy consumption of UE. By leveraging the mobility of UAV, the maximum transmission rate of tasks for terminal devices is ensured. Based on this, the IOECA algorithm proposed in this paper is used to obtain the optimal offloading decision variables. The algorithm proposed in this paper effectively reduces the total energy consumption of UE.

articleTitle: Single-View 3D Model Fast Reconstruction Method Based on Mesh Deformation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Object model reconstruction plays a vital role in enabling robotic tasks, such as grasping and human-robot collaboration technology. However, the reconstruction methods based on single-view images lack depth information and suffer from lower quality reconstruction for occluded parts, which limits the model's robustness and generalization capabilities. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a single-view 3D model reconstruction method based on model retrieval and deformation. By constructing a database to store source models and incorporating graph convolution and attention mechanisms in network design, the method enables efficient model selection and surface reconstruction. Additionally, a simulation scene is established for validating the object grasp. This method holds significant potential for applications in human-machine collaborative scene, providing an effective solution for object K-Nearest Neighbor grasp tasks.

articleTitle: A time-frequency domain fractal method for detecting moving targets in sea clutter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The statistical properties of sea clutter change with the sea state, wind direction, and incidence angle, which leads to the unstable performance of target detection methods based on the statistical model of amplitude. To address this problem, this paper proposes a method for motion target detection using fractal indices within the time-frequency domain. The method firstly performs a short-time Fourier transform in the pulse dimension to obtain the time-Doppler sequence of the signal, then calculates the fractal Hurst index for each Doppler time sequence, and then realizes the detection of the target based on the fractal index, and at the same time realizes the distance-Doppler estimation of the target. In order to improve the application value of the algorithm, the application flow of the algorithm based on CFAR pre-processing is constructed based on the sparse characteristics of the target. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by the processing of real measurement data.

articleTitle: An improved whale optimization algorithm based on multi-populations and multi-strategies for multilevel threshold image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Multilevel threshold image segmentation is one of the most widely used methods. Thus, the determination of the best thresholds is crucial. Swarm intelligence optimization algorithm has been widely used to solve the optimal thresholds. However, the quality and accuracy of segmented image are not enough. In order to improve the quality and accuracy of segmented images, this paper proposes an improved whale optimization algorithm based on multi-populations and multi-strategies(MMWOA). To verify the performance of MMWOA, two sets of experiments are designed: the first group of experiments consists of 5 benchmark functions; using Kapur and Otsu as the objective functions for the second set of experiments to execute multilevel threshold segmentation on 5 grayscale images. The experimental results show that the MMWOA is better than other three swarm intelligence algorithms in astringency and segmentation quality.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-SIMAM: An effective method for SAR ship detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is an all-weather sensor extensively employed in military investigations, maritime rescue operations, and maritime transport management. However, the accuracy of ship detection in SAR images significantly influences the success of these tasks. To improve ship detection performance, we modify its structure and deploy the attention module on the YOLOv7 network. In deep learning, an attention-based model has better results than a convolution neural network. To solve the problem that embedding attention mechanism into convolutional neural network (CNN) has limited ability to extract spatial features and increased computational amount, we adopted SIMAM attention mechanism not only avoids introducing extra parameters but also concentrates on the feature space distribution across different channels, facilitating the efficient extraction of ship positions in high-resolution SAR images. Experimental results on the publicly measured SAR ship detection dataset (SSDD) demonstrate a 3.3% improvement in accuracy for the proposed SIMAM-YOLOv7 over the original YOLOv7. In summary, the proposed method offers a better alternative or complementary approach to ship detection in SAR images than the benchmark YOLOv7 model.

articleTitle: Indoor Localization Method Based on WOA Algorithm Optimization of Xgboost
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Due to the complex and dynamic nature of indoor environments, satellite signals are severely obstructed by indoor structures when propagating indoors. Therefore, indoor positioning technologies are needed to replace satellite signals for obtaining location information. With the rapid advancements in communication technology and artificial intelligence, AI-based indoor positioning techniques can effectively achieve indoor localization. This paper proposes a machine learning-based indoor positioning technique that utilizes the WOA-optimized XGBoost algorithm to predict the target location in a WiFi-based indoor positioning system. For dynamic targets, the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) is employed to fuse measurements and achieve precise position estimation.

articleTitle: Influence of Implantation Depth of Semi-Implantable Devices in Different Tissues on Radio-frequency Heating
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In MRI, the implantable or semi-implantable medical devices can have safety implications for the wearer. For semi-implantable medical devices, the depth of implantation and the electrical conductivity of the medium can influence the distribution of radio-frequency (RF) electric fields. Therefore, an analysis of RF heating for devices with different implantation depths in different media is required. This study begins with the principles of RF heating in MRI, establishes models for RF coils, body phantoms, and standard active implantable device, and employs electromagnetic field simulation methods to investigate the RF heating of devices in terms of both implantation depth and medium conductivity. The results indicate that greater implantation depth and higher medium conductivity lead to lower RF heating temperature rises.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Morel Planting System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Morels have a unique aroma, contain a variety of amino acids needed by the human body, and have important edible value, so they are favored by the general public. However, morels have strict requirements for the growth environment, making it difficult to grow morels higher cost. In order to increase the yield of morels and reduce planting costs, this article designed a morel planting system based on Internet of Things technology. The system uses sensors to collect environmental parameters, and sends the data to the Arduino microprocessor through serial communication. The sensor data is filtered, calculated, and packaged on the microprocessor. The Arduino microprocessor controls various smart devices in the system based on these data. Execute the device to keep the system environmental parameters within a range suitable for the growth of morels. At the same time, the current environmental parameters are displayed through the OLED screen. At the same time, the Arduino microprocessor sends the packaged data to the ESP8266 Wi-Fi module using the serial port. The module sends data to the host computer written by Qt through the TCP communication protocol, and uses the Qpainter class and Qchart class provided by Qt to visualize the host computer data, convert the data into line charts and dashboards, and store historical data in the database, and at the same time, the relevant components on Qt are used to issue instructions to achieve the purpose of remote control of the execution device.

articleTitle: Efficient Beam Training for Fluid Antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Fluid antenna systems (FASs) possess the capability to freely adjust their positions within a seamlessly connected spatial domain. The acquisition of channel state information (CSI) is crucial to maintaining optimal antenna placements for these flexible antenna systems. In large-scale antenna systems, beam training is a common method for user position estimation. By scanning different directions in space, users can determine their locations based on received power and provide feedback to the base station, enabling subsequent information transmission. However, as the number of antennas increases, the system can form finer beams, resulting in an expanded set of candidate directions and consequently leading to significant overhead in beam training. To realize effective beam training in FASs, we propose an efficient beam training framework in this paper. Specifically, the beam training framework comprises two phases. In the first phase, the antenna spacing is expanded to several times the half-wavelength, forming directional beams pointing to multiple directions. On the user side, the approximate candidate orientations are efficiently determined based on the received energy levels. In the second phase, building upon the roughly identified candidate directions from the previous phase, a detailed search for user positions is conducted. This process ultimately pinpoints the user locations, allowing secure data transmission by configuring directional beams for transmission. Simulation results reveal that the proposed scheme can realize effective beam training in FASs.

articleTitle: Effect Analysis of Phase-changing Coherent Jamming on Power Inversion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Adaptive nulling antenna is widely used in the field of navigation anti-jamming. It is usually implemented using power inversion (PI) algorithm and can suppress jamming effectively. In order to improve the ability of interference, a new jamming strategy is proposed in this paper, which called Phase-changing coherent jamming. It continuously changes the form of interference by changing the phase information of coherent jamming. This paper first introduces the optimization algorithms of PI algorithm, including the Least Mean Square (LMS), Recursive Least Squares (RLS), and Sampling Matrix Inversion (SMI); Then, an array model under two coherent jammers is established for analysis. Finally, the effect of several PI algorithms under Phase-changing coherent jamming is studied through simulation. The results show that proposed jamming is difficult to filtered by LMS algorithm, while other algorithms can effectively remove this jammer, which could provide references for the design of jammer and the selection of anti-jamming algorithms.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Classification Network Based on 3D Marginal Self-Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: In recent years, due to the deep application of deep learning technology, hyperspectral image classification technology has made remarkable break throughs. However, due to the limited number of HSI data samples, traditional CNNS are not sufficient to learn the spatial and spectral features of HSI, resulting in unsatisfactory classification results. To solve the above problems, a hybrid classification framework for hyperspectral images based on 3D marginal self-attention mechanism, 3DMSAMNet, is proposed. The framework is composed of three modules, 3D marginal self-attention mechanism network (3DMSAM), spectral dense module (SDM) and spatial reconstruction module (SRM), which complement each other in performance. Firstly, the designed 3DMSAM extracts the hidden mixed features of HSI from the spatial and spectral dimensions through the marginal filter branch and the attention divergence branch, which makes the extracted feature information more comprehensive. SRM learns more spatial features without increasing spatial redundancy, and SDM then enhances the reusability of spectral features through dense connectivity. The results show that the overall accuracy of the 3DMSAMNet model is 1.43%, 3.32% and 1.93% higher than that of the latest DBMA model on 3% Indian Pines, 0.5% Pavia University and Salinas Valley HSI public datasets, respectively. Therefore, in the case of limited samples, 3DMSAMNet has higher classification accuracy and stronger generalization ability for HSI classification.

articleTitle: Research on image pre-processing techniques for multimode data metrology detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: The test and inspection business in the metrology field and laboratory in the electric power field faces the problems of low degree of automation of experimental data flow, high degree of heterogeneity of sensor transmission signals, low degree of resource management sharing and low degree of intelligence. In the paper, orthogonal projection, perspective projection and other projection transformations are used to rotate the image, and deep learning is used to achieve the correction of distorted document images to complete the image preprocessing of multimode data metrology testing. The experimental results show that the image preprocessing technology proposed in the article can effectively restore the metrology detection image.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Based on Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Federated learning is a distributed machine learning method that has important research significance in areas such as privacy, data heterogeneity, communication efficiency, and incentive mechanisms. Data imbalance is a key challenge faced by federated learning. Due to the non iid nature of the data provided by each client in federated learning, the client is unable to obtain a good local model during client training. The iterative process of uploading, aggregating, and downloading the model hinders its ability to make accurate predictions. In order to solve the problem of data imbalance, this paper constructs multiple auxiliary branches in the local model and fuses their features to improve the prediction accuracy of the model in the case of data imbalance. The experimental results show that the model has improved performance in both scenarios of simulating 100 and 500 clients.

articleTitle: CARLP: A Counterfactual Augmentation and Fusion Representation Model for Link Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Link prediction is a crucial component of knowledge graphs (KGs) as it aids in the analysis, completion, and application of KGs. Existing methods focus on learning the association between the observed graph structure and the links between a pair of nodes. However, they overlook the fact that KGs consist of interconnected nodes, and there exists a causal relationship between these nodes. Therefore, it is important to consider the causal relationship between nodes while performing link prediction in KGs. In this paper, we propose a Counterfactual Augmentation and Fusion Representation Model for Link Prediction (CARLP) that uses causality between nodes as a data augmentation of the KG. To address the poor effect of embedded representation due to the lack of link data in KG, we introduce Fusion Embedding to extract more dimensional information from KG. Additionally, we propose the ODE-Encoder to adjust the depth of the neural network by choosing a discretization scheme, making the neural network more accurate. Our experiments on KG Link Prediction demonstrate the effectiveness and genericity of the CRALP. It achieves 97.19% ± 0.18%, 97.99%± 0.17%, and 99.46%± 0.03% AUC values, and achieves 76.66%± 2.36%, 87.10%± 1.88%, and 60.21% ± 2.31% Hit@20 values on Cora, Citeseer and Facebook KGs. In particular, comparing with GCN, CRALP improves 5.08%, 3.92% and 13.00% on AUC, Hit@20 and AP, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on TCP transmission performance optimization based on satellite communication conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: This article proposes directions for improving TCP transmission performance by analyzing the impact of satellite communication link characteristics on TCP. We conducted in-depth research on the application of various TCP congestion control strategies on satellite communication lines and determined the optimal choice suitable for satellite network environments. Especially when using the SACK algorithm, in order to include more data in the SACK option, we propose an optimization method based on basic numbering and offset. After simulation experiments, it has been verified that this new method can significantly improve the transmission rate of satellite communication lines.

articleTitle: Research on bank credit risk control based on AE-CatBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of society, the scale of credit business is also expanding. This thesis conducts research on machine learning to accurately assess borrowers' credit risks based on a public data set of loan records from a certain credit platform. By combining the deep learning model AutoEncoder and the integrated learning model CatBoost, the AE-CatBoost model was proposed. Various evaluation indicators were compared through experiments and it was found that the AUC value of AE-CatBoost model is about 0.034 higher than that of CatBoost model. The proposal of AE-CatBoost has important practical significance for the development of bank credit risk control.

articleTitle: Efficient Multi-interval Attention Retractable Network for Image Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Recently, many algorithms employing deep neural networks have been developed for image compressed sensing (CS) and have made significant strides in reconstructing image details. However, the performance of DNN-based reconstruction methods is limited by the fact that the inherent inductive bias of convolutional operations prevents them from capturing long-range dependencies of images. In this work, we propose an Efficient Multi-interval Attention Retractable Network (EMARNet) for CS image reconstruction. EMARNet employs a network architecture composed of multiple residual Transformer blocks as the core of the reconstruction process. Specifically, each Transformer block comprises a sequence of interconnected Dense Attention Block (DAB) and Group-wise Multi-interval Sparse Attention Block (GM-SAB), alongside a residual connection. The cascaded DABs and GM-SABs can effectively capture the global information and achieve better reconstruction quality. Experimental results on diverse benchmark datasets confirm the superior performance of our proposed approach compare to state-of-the-art CS methods.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based EEG Signal Identity Recognition Using VGGNet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: This study presents the utilization of the VGGNet deep convolutional neural network, specifically the VGG-16 model, for EEG signal identity recognition. VGGNet, developed by the Visual Geometry Group at the University of Oxford and Google DeepMind, emphasizes the significance of network depth in enhancing performance and generalization capability. In the context of EEG signal topography image identification, the research leverages VGG-16 as a reference model, underscoring its feature extraction capabilities. The paper details the parameter settings and tuning processes during model training, with a specific focus on Dropout parameters, optimizer selection, and learning rate determination. Using the TensorFlow framework, the model's training and evaluation were visualized with Tensorboard. To validate the model's generalizability, a 5-fold cross-validation method was employed. The proposed deep learning-based approach for EEG signal identity recognition is based on the conversion of 3D brain electrode mappings to 2D multispectral images, preserving spatial and spectral features. The results indicate an impressive 86.79% identity recognition accuracy under low brain load conditions, showcasing the method's efficacy. This approach offers a nearly 10% improvement in accuracy compared to traditional single-channel, single-band 1D EEG identification methods.

articleTitle: VE-YOLOv6: A Lightweight Small Target Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: At present, there are still many obstacles for small target detection in the field of computer vision. Although the existing target detection technology can extract the semantic information of small targets by multi-scale fusion and other methods, the detection speed is not ideal. In this paper, the target detection algorithm of YOLOv6 is improved by lightweight. On the basis of VGNetG architecture, a lighter Backbone is redesigned, and ECA attention mechanism with extended position information is introduced to make up for some loss in detection accuracy, so as to ensure that the model can obtain lower computation without obvious decrease in detection accuracy. According to the test experiment of DOTA, a public data set, the FPS of VE-YOLOv6 proposed in this paper increases by 73, and the model computation and parameter number decrease by 18.91 and 2.8M, respectively, when the mAP decrease is not obvious with the original YOLOv6 algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction model of pedestrian crossing intention at intersections Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: At present, the mixed conditions at road intersections are more prominent, pedestrians crossing the street and vehicles turning often collide, which has a great impact on the safety of pedestrians. Although the pedestrian alarm system on the car has played a very good role in improving the road traffic safety, due to the high false alarm rate of this method, the driver lacks a good way to deal with it. Therefore, in order to solve the problem of accurate prediction of pedestrian crossing intention and improve the safety of pedestrian crossing, this paper takes urban unsignalized intersections as an example, analyzes the influencing factors of pedestrian crossing intention, and selects the distance between the vehicle and the zebra crossing, the speed before the pedestrian crossing, and the distance to collision time TTC as the key features. Finally, a model based on LSTM is constructed, and the correct recognition rate of the model reaches 95.05%. Compared with other deep learning models, the performance of the model in RMSE and MAE indicators is significantly improved, and it can better judge the intention of pedestrians to cross the street.

articleTitle: Distribution network insulation fault risk warning method based on LSTM and FCM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Statistics show that most power outages are caused by distribution network insulation failure. It is difficult to detect the insulation deterioration of distribution network in time, and the failure to effectively warn the insulation fault brings difficulties to the inspection work of distribution network. In order to assist the distribution and transportation inspection department to take effective prevention and control measures to improve the reliability of distribution network, a distribution network insulation fault early warning model based on long short-term memory network (LSTM) and fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm is proposed. First, by classifying the operation data of the power grid, 25 characteristic variables of the distribution network are selected, and the principal component analysis method is used to fuse the characteristic variables to form low-dimensional characteristic variables that can characterize the operation state of the distribution network. Then, based on the fused feature variables, FCM clustering algorithm is used to identify the boundary conditions for the distinction between the insulated fault state and the non-insulated fault state of the distribution network, and LSTM is used to predict the characteristic quantity of the distribution network in the short term, and the fault occurrence time in the short term is predicted by combining the characteristic quantity prediction results and the obtained state boundary conditions. Realize insulation fault early warning; Finally, taking the operation data of 39 feeder lines in a prefecture-level city as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: TrojanNet Attack on Human Pose Estimation Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Neural Networks, Information and Communication Engineering (NNICE)
abstract: Human pose estimation has achieved significant progress in recent years.
